rationale: The agent did identify the user via name and ZIP (find_user_id_by_name_zip, get_user_details), but then executed multiple order-changing actions without explicit user confirmation: two cancellations (#W9373487, #W5481803) and two returns (#W2692684, #W7449508). Policy requires confirming every order-changing action before taking it, and the conversation shows no confirmation prompts—only a generic closing message. Additionally, the user asked for the tracking number and to explore refund/reorder options for the lost tablet; there is no evidence the agent provided the tracking number or addressed the refund/reorder policy or a handoff to a human if needed. The actions taken also do not clearly match the user’s specific requests (cancel charger, boot, kettle; return sneaker), and the agent performed multiple actions at once despite the user’s preference to do one thing at a time. These issues violate the policy and indicate the request was not properly completed.
